title: Project Convention
description: A reusable development practice, coding standard, or engineering convention applicable to a project or a defined part of it.

schema_version.description: The version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this convention document.

id.description: A stable, unique identifier assigned and verified by the Extension. The identifier remains stable across revisions of the convention.

title.description: A concise human-readable title identifying the development convention.

description.description: An explanation of the convention, the development context in which it applies, and the problem it is intended to prevent or solve.

level.description: The applicability level of the convention. Project applies across the repository; directory and module indicate narrower scopes.

items.description: A repository-relative path identifying a directory or module covered by the convention.

paths.description: Repository-relative paths identifying the directories or modules covered by the convention. An empty array means that no narrower path restriction is specified.

scope.description: The scope within which contributors and Agents are expected to follow the convention.

practice.description: The recommended or required development practice. Express the expected behavior precisely enough for implementation and review.

rationale.description: The reason for adopting the convention, such as maintainability, consistency, reliability, security, or compatibility.

enforcement.description: The primary enforcement method. Automated means a configured tool can check compliance; agent_review requires explicit Agent inspection; human_review requires human judgment.

verification_instructions.description: Instructions describing how to check adherence, including the relevant tooling, review criteria, or expected evidence.

kind.description: Whether the example demonstrates compliant behavior or behavior that violates the convention.

description.description: An explanation of what the example demonstrates and why it is compliant or non-compliant.

code.description: A representative code snippet or textual example illustrating the convention.

items.description: A positive or negative example that clarifies the expected development practice.

examples.description: Examples used by Agents and developers to understand and review the convention. An empty array is permitted when no meaningful example is available.

status.description: The lifecycle status of the convention. The Extension controls approval and status transitions; an Agent cannot authorize a convention merely by setting this field.
